breakdown.description: The transverse modulus should follow the inverse rule of mixtures, not the parallel rule.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to correct the core inconsistency. The incomplete prompt provided the incorrect formula (the parallel rule of mixtures) for the transverse modulus. The agent repeated this incorrect formula, `E_T = V_f * E_f + V_m * E_m`, instead of correcting it to the inverse rule of mixtures, `1/E_T = V_f/E_f + V_m/E_m`, as specified in the ground truth.
